thought.text: The config looks correct. Let me check if Node is actually listening on port 3000:

reasoning_content: The config looks like it should serve static files when the backend is down (using error_page 502 503 504 = @static_fallback), but the issue is that the node server IS running but on port 3000 it just can't accept connections. Let me check if Node is listening on port 3000:

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

# Check what listens on 3000
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("netstat -tlnp | grep 3000 2>&1")
print("Port 3000:", stdout.read().decode())

# Check PM2 again
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("pm2 list 2>&1")
print("\nPM2:", stdout.read().decode())

# Check latest logs
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("tail -30 /var/log/areloria/out-0.log 2>&1")
print("\nLogs:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
EOF
